title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Extension
content: In accordance with the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 (PRA), the Federal Trade Commission (FTC or Commission) is seeking public comment on its proposal to reinstate and extend for three additional years the information collections contained in the FTC's rule entitled "Use of Prenotification Negative Option Plans" ("Negative Option Rule" or "Rule") as that rule was written before courts vacated the final rule promulgated on November 15, 2024. The current clearance expires on November 30, 2027.
